question: Which word precisely completes this KJV verse? “And the king’s servants said unto him, Behold, ___ standeth in the court. And the king said, Let him come in.”
explanation: Esther 6:5 (KJV): “And the king’s servants said unto him, Behold, Haman standeth in the court. And the king said, Let him come in.”

question: Which word precisely completes this KJV verse? “Let us not be desirous of vain glory, provoking one another, ___ one another.”
explanation: Galatians 5:26 (KJV): “Let us not be desirous of vain glory, provoking one another, envying one another.”

question: Which word precisely completes this KJV verse? “And the multitude crying aloud ___ to desire him to do as he had ever done unto them.”
explanation: Mark 15:8 (KJV): “And the multitude crying aloud began to desire him to do as he had ever done unto them.”

question: Which word precisely completes this KJV verse? “And he shall put off his garments, and put on other garments, and carry forth the ashes without the camp unto a ___ place.”
explanation: Leviticus 6:11 (KJV): “And he shall put off his garments, and put on other garments, and carry forth the ashes without the camp unto a clean place.”

question: Which word precisely completes this KJV verse? “Our inheritance is ___ to strangers, our houses to aliens.”
explanation: Lamentations 5:2 (KJV): “Our inheritance is turned to strangers, our houses to aliens.”

question: Which word precisely completes this KJV verse? “And when the queen of Sheba ___ of the fame of Solomon concerning the name of the LORD, she came to prove him with hard questions.”
explanation: 1 Kings 10:1 (KJV): “And when the queen of Sheba heard of the fame of Solomon concerning the name of the LORD, she came to prove him with hard questions.”

question: Which word precisely completes this KJV verse? “And the sons of Becher; Zemira, and Joash, and Eliezer, and Elioenai, and Omri, and Jerimoth, and Abiah, and Anathoth, and ___. All these are the sons of Becher.”
explanation: 1 Chronicles 7:8 (KJV): “And the sons of Becher; Zemira, and Joash, and Eliezer, and Elioenai, and Omri, and Jerimoth, and Abiah, and Anathoth, and Alameth. All these are the sons of Becher.”

question: Which word precisely completes this KJV verse? “I ___ therefore, that, first of all, supplications, prayers, intercessions, and giving of thanks, be made for all men;”
explanation: 1 Timothy 2:1 (KJV): “I exhort therefore, that, first of all, supplications, prayers, intercessions, and giving of thanks, be made for all men;”

question: Which word precisely completes this KJV verse? “Duke Dishon, duke Ezer, duke Dishan: these are the dukes that came of Hori, among their ___ in the land of Seir.”
explanation: Genesis 36:30 (KJV): “Duke Dishon, duke Ezer, duke Dishan: these are the dukes that came of Hori, among their dukes in the land of Seir.”

question: Which word precisely completes this KJV verse? “And the arches thereof were toward the utter court; and palm ___ were upon the posts thereof: and the going up to it had eight steps.”
explanation: Ezekiel 40:31 (KJV): “And the arches thereof were toward the utter court; and palm trees were upon the posts thereof: and the going up to it had eight steps.”

question: Which word precisely completes this KJV verse? “For yourselves know ___ that the day of the Lord so cometh as a thief in the night.”
explanation: 1 Thessalonians 5:2 (KJV): “For yourselves know perfectly that the day of the Lord so cometh as a thief in the night.”

question: Which word precisely completes this KJV verse? “That he might sanctify and ___ it with the washing of water by the word,”
explanation: Ephesians 5:26 (KJV): “That he might sanctify and cleanse it with the washing of water by the word,”

question: Which word precisely completes this KJV verse? “And of the sons of Harim; Eliezer, Ishijah, Malchiah, ___, Shimeon,”
explanation: Ezra 10:31 (KJV): “And of the sons of Harim; Eliezer, Ishijah, Malchiah, Shemaiah, Shimeon,”

question: Which word precisely completes this KJV verse? “Hear, all ye people; ___, O earth, and all that therein is: and let the Lord GOD be witness against you, the Lord from his holy temple.”
explanation: Micah 1:2 (KJV): “Hear, all ye people; hearken, O earth, and all that therein is: and let the Lord GOD be witness against you, the Lord from his holy temple.”

question: Which word precisely completes this KJV verse? “And the king said, Let him turn to his own house, and let him not see my face. So Absalom ___ to his own house, and saw not the king’s face.”
explanation: 2 Samuel 14:24 (KJV): “And the king said, Let him turn to his own house, and let him not see my face. So Absalom returned to his own house, and saw not the king’s face.”

question: Which word precisely completes this KJV verse? “Behold, God is my ___; I will trust, and not be afraid: for the LORD JEHOVAH is my strength and my song; he also is become my salvation.”
explanation: Isaiah 12:2 (KJV): “Behold, God is my salvation; I will trust, and not be afraid: for the LORD JEHOVAH is my strength and my song; he also is become my salvation.”

question: Which word precisely completes this KJV verse? “He trusted in God; let him ___ him now, if he will have him: for he said, I am the Son of God.”
explanation: Matthew 27:43 (KJV): “He trusted in God; let him deliver him now, if he will have him: for he said, I am the Son of God.”

question: Which word precisely completes this KJV verse? “Let there more work be laid upon the men, that they may ___ therein; and let them not regard vain words.”
explanation: Exodus 5:9 (KJV): “Let there more work be laid upon the men, that they may labour therein; and let them not regard vain words.”

question: Which word precisely completes this KJV verse? “Get you up from among this congregation, that I may ___ them as in a moment. And they fell upon their faces.”
explanation: Numbers 16:45 (KJV): “Get you up from among this congregation, that I may consume them as in a moment. And they fell upon their faces.”

question: Which word precisely completes this KJV verse? “When the most High divided to the nations their inheritance, when he separated the sons of Adam, he set the bounds of the people according to the number of the children of ___.”
explanation: Deuteronomy 32:8 (KJV): “When the most High divided to the nations their inheritance, when he separated the sons of Adam, he set the bounds of the people according to the number of the children of Israel.”

question: Which word precisely completes this KJV verse? “Let such an one ___ this, that, such as we are in word by letters when we are absent, such will we be also in deed when we are present.”
explanation: 2 Corinthians 10:11 (KJV): “Let such an one think this, that, such as we are in word by letters when we are absent, such will we be also in deed when we are present.”

question: Which word precisely completes this KJV verse? “Also Bakbukiah and Unni, their ___, were over against them in the watches.”
explanation: Nehemiah 12:9 (KJV): “Also Bakbukiah and Unni, their brethren, were over against them in the watches.”
